# Stakeholder Communication Plan Template

**Owner:** [Stakeholder Liaison](../octoacme-roles-and-personas.md#stakeholder-liaison)
**Related docs:** [Roles & Personas](../octoacme-roles-and-personas.md) | [Risk Management & Communication](../octoacme-risks-and-communication.md) | [Project Initiation Guide](../octoacme-project-initiation.md)

## Purpose
Map stakeholder groups, define communication needs and cadence, and ensure consistent two-way communication throughout the project lifecycle. The Stakeholder Liaison owns this plan and reviews it with the Project Manager at project initiation and at each major milestone.

## Usage Notes
- Create one Stakeholder Communication Plan per project and store it in the project's `docs/` folder.
- Review and update the stakeholder map when team composition, scope, or priorities change.
- Share relevant sections with the Communication Lead for inclusion in status reporting.

---

## 1. Stakeholder Map

| Stakeholder Name / Group | Role / Relationship | Interest / Concern | Influence Level (High/Med/Low) | Primary Contact |
|--------------------------|--------------------|--------------------|-------------------------------|----------------|
| _Example: Executive Sponsor_ | Approves budget and scope | Overall delivery, strategic alignment | High | |
| _Example: End Users / Customers_ | Consume the product | Usability, reliability | High | |
| _Example: Engineering Team_ | Build and deploy | Technical requirements, capacity | Medium | |
| _Example: Support Team_ | Handle user issues | Known issues, release notes | Medium | |
| | | | | |

---

## 2. Communication Cadence

| Audience | Communication Type | Frequency | Channel | Owner | Notes |
|----------|--------------------|-----------|---------|-------|-------|
| Executive Sponsor | Status update | Monthly | Email / slides | Stakeholder Liaison | Include key risks and decisions |
| External Stakeholders | Progress update | Milestone-based | Email / meeting | Stakeholder Liaison | Coordinate with Communication Lead |
| Internal Team | Standup / sync | Weekly | Meeting / chat | Project Manager | |
| Support Team | Release briefing | Per release | Email | Deployment Coordinator | Include known issues |
| All Stakeholders | Major announcements | As needed | Email / announcement | Communication Lead | |

---

## 3. Key Milestones & Stakeholder Touchpoints

| Milestone | Stakeholders to Notify | Communication Type | Owner |
|-----------|------------------------|-------------------|-------|
| Project kickoff | All stakeholders | Kickoff meeting / email | Stakeholder Liaison |
| Planning complete | Executive Sponsor, key stakeholders | Summary email | Stakeholder Liaison |
| Release / deployment | External stakeholders, support | Release announcement | Deployment Coordinator + Stakeholder Liaison |
| Project close | All stakeholders | Closure report | Stakeholder Liaison |

---

## 4. Feedback & Escalation Process

- **Gathering feedback**: Stakeholder Liaison collects feedback via surveys, meetings, or direct communication and shares with the Product Manager.
- **Triage**: Product Manager and Stakeholder Liaison triage feedback for prioritization in the backlog.
- **Escalation**: Unresolved stakeholder conflicts are escalated by the Stakeholder Liaison to the Project Manager → Product Lead.

---
